main_text.p: variis variarum scholarum libris disperfa sunt, disputata etiam, neq; tamé ab eo descripta: imó verò quæcunq; pro assidua & fraterna consuetudine ex eo audivi ac didici. Atq; id P. Ramo primum restituendæ & reformandę Dialecticæ fundamentum propositum erit: secundum autem erit in exemplis & artis, & artificiosæ commentationis, id est, in usu artis & fructu demonstrando. Exempla verò poetarum & oratorum á P. Ramo multorum annorum professione & labore observata & animadversa equidem plurimi facio, quia demonstrat artis & veritatem & utilitatē. Hippocrates, Leo, Theudius, Hermotimus, Euclides, mathematicorum elementorum authores perhibentur: non quia elementa ipsa invenisse, sed quia facilius demonstrasse existimantur. At qui demonstratio logicorum theorematum vera & germana fit per exepla præstantium logicorum. Tota logica legitimè descripta definitionib. & partitionib. coponitur: quę quia principia sunt, aliam quàm insigniū exemplorū demonstratio nè non recipiūt: Et sic ἐμπειρία, ἱστορία, διὰ δνσις, ἐπαγωγὴ, experiētia, observatio, sensus, inductio (ut Aristot. 14. cap 1. Post & in Philosophia 1. cap. 1. li. bri profitetur) omnium artiū theorematā peperērūt. Quamobré nobilibus exēplis, variis præsertim ac disparibus, variasq; præstantium ingeniorū dotes in unā doctrinę gloriā veluti cōspirantiū demōstrationibus tantū tribuo, quantū accuratisimæ demonstrationi logicæ artis tribui posfit. Exempla verò poetica & oratoria P. Ramus ad illustrandū & demonstrandū logicæ artis

page.notes: Line numbers 5–30 in the left margin are marginal line markers, not text. Greek words in the passage (ἐμπειρία, ἱστορία, διδυνσις, ἐπαγωγή) are reproduced approximately from a small, blurred print; the line "Et sic" and the Greek are uncertain. The word "artis" at the foot is a catchword-like line set at right and is treated as the final word of the text. Several words are uncertain due to print quality and are not individually marked.
